newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Mazel, Panavision gain.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Mazel, Panavision gain.

text.p: Mazel Stores Inc and Panavision Inc both saw solid gains on their first day of trading.

Shares of Panavision Inc were at 20 in afternoon trading, up 3 from their IPO price of $17. The 2.8 million share deal, led by Goldman Sachs, had an estimated pricing range of $16 to $18 per share. The company designs and manufactures high-precision film camera systems.

Mazel's shares rose 2-3/4 to 18-3/4. The 2.574 million share issue priced at the top of its upwardly revised price range at $16. William Blair was the underwriter. Solon, Ohio-based Mazel is a regional closeout retailer and wholesaler.
Other companies that made their debut on Thursday:

-Perfume and cosmetics firm Styling Technology Corp STYL.O shares were down 1/2, to 9-1/2, from their IPO price of $10. The company offered 2.9 million shares in a deal led by Friedman, Billings, Ramsey.
- Applied Intelligence Group Inc IQIQ.O shares rose 3/8 to 5-3/8. The one million share IPO was lead managed by Barron Chase Securities.
-Integrated Surgical Systems Inc RDOC.O shares were flat at their IPO price of $5. The company offered 1.525 million shares in a deal led by Rickel & Associates.
